title: SOP 205 version history and website-posting records
summary:
Asked for prior versions of SOP 205 (with changelog or revision history), the URL where SOP 205 is posted on the SMPD website, and any records of past posting.

Produced SOP 205 (Oct 2019) and SOP 205 (Feb 2021). Agency stated: 'Lexipol has confirmed that a formal changelog does not exist,' and 'The Department does not currently have the associated SOPs posted on its website. We acknowledge this oversight and are actively working to ensure the SOPs are published as soon as possible.'

policy_promises.quote: This Operating Procedure, along with SMPD Lexipol Policy 462, shall be posted conspicuously on our Department website.
policy_promises.tests: Where on the SMPD website is SOP 205 posted, and what records reflect when it was posted?

policy_promises.quote: ALPR usage and privacy policy shall be implemented, available to the public, and posted conspicuously
policy_promises.tests: How does the agency's posting practice line up with the statute's conspicuous-posting requirement?

filed_because: SOP 205 references its own posting on the Department website. The request asks for prior versions, the current URL, and any records of past posting.
notes:
The agency's 2026-03-03 response acknowledged that the SOPs were not posted and committed to publishing them.

W012571-042026 (filed 2026-04-20) followed up on the posting commitment.
